disposition: full at original ordinary compiler/boot boundary

contract.title: Verify cross-package normal directives and authored boot semantics
contract.goal: Classify normal versus simple package directives and document the authored-project boot boundary without claiming the simple literal case is a bug.
steps: Build a disposable XML consumer with a normal-format umbrella and two statically required normal packages; test cross-package #use root/solution, #source transit and unresolved-address typed failure.
Compare the same authored snippet under simple format, where #use remains literal by contract, and verify #embed behavior without conflating the two formats.

Document that a project-owned static boot file named by INDEX is read as authored instructions rather than compiled as a package snippet; specify #source placement from parser behavior, including section/top-level versus last-line rule.
positive_cases: Normal cross-package #use inlines the exact target and source closure once; simple retains literal text.
An unresolved normal #use refuses before committing a changed boot lane.
negative_cases: The simple literal observation is labeled a confirmed normal-format bug.
A #source paragraph is silently accepted or relocated without its actual syntax rule.
checks: SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: bind the affected vibe-workspace/vibe-cli/vibe-spec target and exact regression cases from source before compiling; use --lib or a named integration target.
RUN BOUND CHECKS: cargo test -p vibe-workspace --lib <reviewed case> -- --exact or the corresponding affected named target; require one nonzero selected case.
CONDITIONAL ORACLE: run codegen/specmap only if a changed schema, generator, source index or dependent contract actually requires it; do not use a broad gate from write perimeter alone.
acceptance: Classify normal versus simple package directives and document the authored-project boot boundary without claiming the simple literal case is a bug.
Disposable positive and negative evidence is reviewed; any unavailable native Windows proof remains open rather than waived.
contract.safe_stop: Keep the regression reproducible in a disposable fixture and report exact unsupported behavior until the affected path is fixed.
notes: Product-neutral regressions observed on a separate local main are hypotheses for this next checkout until disposable current-tree tests prove them. Do not copy fixture-specific package names or publish external package sets.
Maintain the mutable 1.1.0 cohort and the no-public-Git hold. Bind only affected tests; no mutation suite or routine whole-workspace gate.
